title: Van L NDE 871
content:
Came into a beautiful garden with soft colors A park in perfect harmony with a blue sky Summer-like spring Beautiful building, kind of monastery Beautiful hallway with huge chandeliers At the end of the hallway a strong yet soft light While entering the building I was stopped by three close, yet deceased, relatives I spoke to the three of them The last one told me that it was too early to enter Then came back to the world with beautiful visions.

Came into a beautiful garden with soft colors

A park in perfect harmony with a blue sky

Summer-like spring

Beautiful building, kind of monastery

Beautiful hallway with huge chandeliers

At the end of the hallway a strong yet soft light

While entering the building I was stopped by three close, yet deceased, relatives

I spoke to the three of them

The last one told me that it was too early to enter

Then came back to the world with beautiful visions.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes AccidentSurgery-related Life threatening event, but not clinical death A serious traffic accident.
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Boundary
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes See above. They were at the entrance of the hall. Two of them spoke to me in the same words as they said to me just before they died themselves. The third one told me it was too early (to enter).
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Bright, yet soft and beautiful.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I visited many beautiful places I had once been in my life and also places which I still want to visit.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Traveling and relational issues.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Even more questions than before.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Amazed, disbelief and sometimes support.
